guards: a Django view renamed in views.py while the app's urls.py, outside the diff, still registers it by its old name is reported

bugs.truth: order_detail was renamed to show_order, but orders/urls.py still registers views.order_detail for orders/<int:pk>/, so loading the URL configuration raises AttributeError and every page of the site fails. Rename the reference in orders/urls.py, or keep the old name.
